sourcing_note: One targeted candidate to close the remaining negative-event reserve gap (buffer was -1 after the previous two batches). Deciphera Pharmaceuticals' INTRIGUE Phase 3 miss is a well-documented, decisively negative, in-window event at a company large enough to clear the investability floor comfortably. Deduplicated against the full existing ticker/candidate_id set (DCPH was not previously in the pool). While researching this candidate, a superficially similar lead (an Ionis/AstraZeneca eplontersen Phase 3 readout) was checked and discarded because its actual date was July 2026, outside the frozen 2018-2025 sampling frame - noted here since that check happened in the same research session as this addition.

events.notes: 453-patient INTRIGUE trial (ripretinib vs. sunitinib, second-line GIST) missed its primary endpoint of progression-free survival in the intention-to-treat population (8.0 vs. 8.3 months, HR 1.05, nominal p=0.72). QINLOCK's existing third-line-plus approval was unaffected; this was specifically a second-line expansion failure.
